registryEntry.label: Security Alert Monitoring Evidence via Defender
registryEntry.get_command: $secInfo = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/security/secureScores?$top=1'; $alerts = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/security/alerts_v2?$top=10').value; [PSCustomObject]@{ secureScoreAvailable = ($secInfo.value.Count -gt 0); recentAlertCount = ($alerts | Measure-Object).Count; alerts = ($alerts | Select-Object id,title,severity,status,createdDateTime) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
evidence_commands: $alerts = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/security/alerts_v2?$top=50').value; [PSCustomObject]@{ alertCount = ($alerts | Measure-Object).Count; alerts = ($alerts | Select-Object id,title,severity,status,createdDateTime) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

metadata.commandExecuted: [manual/evidence-only] Security Alert Monitoring Evidence via Defender
